variants.user_notes: Connect only this iCESugar when programming: its programmer can't tell iCESugar boards apart, so the engine refuses when another board with the same USB IDs, such as an iCESugar-Pro, is connected.
variants.maintainer_notes: iCESugar boards share USB IDs and product name. The serial number's first 4 characters are the board ID, as icesprog's source reads it: 0700 iCESugar, 0710 iCESugar-Pro, 0720 iCESugar-nano. 0700 also seen in a real iCESugar v1.5's USB log.

sys_clk.user_notes: From the on-board iCELink's 12 MHz clock output, through jumper J1.

ai_hints: Wired to the FPGA's RGB LED driver pads: red RGB1, green RGB2, blue RGB0.
Drive it through SB_RGBA_DRV, the iCE40 UltraPlus's RGB LED driver cell (sink only).

switches.user_notes: A 4-way DIP switch with pull-ups, on the same pins as PMOD4.

uart.user_notes: The on-board iCELink's USB serial port, through jumper J5. Also on PMOD1.

pmod1.user_notes: Shared: pins 2 and 8 with the UART (jumper J5), pins 1 and 7 with the micro-USB port.

pmod4.user_notes: A 6-pin PMOD: 4 signals, then GND and 3.3 V. Shared with the DIP switches: turn them off to use it.

ai_hints: SPI flash, a W25Q64 (8 MB): CS 16, SCK 15, FPGA out 14, FPGA in 17, WP 12, HOLD 13.
Micro-USB port data: D+ on 10, D- on 9; 11 drives the 1.5k pull-up on D+.
